name: rules-rtdb-r13-priority-and-index-directive
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r13-priority-and-index-directive" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). a plain `set` leaves priority unset, so `getPriority()` must report null in the simulator exactly as it does in production, and a ruleset carrying `.indexOn` must deploy and evaluate without the directive disturbing any verdict.
